rationale: The workflow already implements several evidence-supported optimizations: (1) Rust dependency caching via Swatinem/rust-cache@v2 (covering P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), (2) extensive path filtering on pull_request triggers (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER), (3) explicit job timeout of 240 minutes (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT), (4) matrix fail-fast disabled with rationale (contraindicated for P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), (5) concurrency control with cancel-in-progress: false (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE not applicable). The evidence patterns either are already implemented, don't apply to this Rust/Cargo self-hosted workflow (Bazel patterns, scheduled workflow patterns), have limited aggregate impact (P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW, P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER), or are contraindicated by the workflow's explicit design choices (fail-fast disabled to preserve independent scenario results). No additional evidence-supported optimization with clear benefit and preserved coverage is identified.
